Umesh V Waghmare Appointed Secretary of Science and Technology Department

Professor Umesh V Waghmare has been appointed as the new Secretary of the Department of Science and Technology. This appointment marks a change in leadership for the department. Further details regarding his role and responsibilities are expected.
